task_types.description: Diagnose the primary problem of a single deep-learning experiment.
Interpret the meaning and limitations of reported evaluation metrics.
Compare multiple runs or models under performance and efficiency constraints.

primary_issues.definition: Training performance continues to improve while validation performance stagnates or degrades, producing a meaningful generalization gap.
Training and validation performance both remain insufficient under otherwise stable optimization, indicating insufficient fitting capacity or learning.
Training is hindered by unstable, divergent, excessively slow, or otherwise abnormal optimization behavior such as inappropriate learning rate or gradient instability.
Class distribution or class-wise performance is strongly uneven and materially affects aggregate metrics or minority-class performance.
Problems such as label noise, duplicates, missing values, corrupted samples, distribution mismatch, or inconsistent preprocessing materially affect the experiment.
The available evidence does not support a clear experiment pathology.
Used when the task does not require assigning a diagnostic issue.
